# sofascore_scraper.store.BackupManager
# kaynak: sofascore_scraper/store/backup.py
class BackupManager:
    def __init__(self, store: 'Store') -> None
    @property
    def directory(self) -> str
    def create(self, scope: str = 'all', *, config_files: Sequence[str] = (), env_file: Optional[str] = None, overrides_file: Optional[str] = None, now: Optional[datetime] = None) -> BackupInfo
    def list(self) -> List[BackupInfo]
    def path_of(self, name: str) -> str
    def verify(self, name: str) -> BackupCheck
    def restore(self, name: str, *, force: bool = False, dry_run: bool = False, overrides_file: Optional[str] = None) -> RestoreReport
    def prune(self, keep: Optional[int] = None, max_age_days: Optional[float] = None, *, now: Optional[datetime] = None) -> List[BackupInfo]
